# Qognition Agency
> The Operating Partner for Founders

Qognition is an AI-native operating partner for founders and growth-stage companies. We run marketing, tech, finance, and automation — so founders can build the business, not manage vendors.

We consolidate four critical business functions into a single operating partnership: one SLA, one relationship, one standard of execution. AI-native from the ground up, not bolted onto traditional agency delivery.

## What We Do

### Marketing — AI-Native Growth Marketing
SEO, AI search visibility (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), paid media (Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn), content strategy, CRO, brand strategy, visual identity, email lifecycle, and social media. Built for measurable revenue, not vanity metrics. Retainers from $3K–$20K/mo.

### Tech — Revenue-Focused Engineering
Marketing websites, web apps and SaaS, headless ecommerce (Shopify), Next.js performance, API integrations, Core Web Vitals optimization, and MVP development. Projects from $10K–$200K.

### Finance — Financial Operations for Founders
Monthly bookkeeping, tax preparation and planning, fractional CFO, payroll management, financial reporting, and cash flow modeling. Retainers from $500/mo.

### Automation — AI Agents & Intelligent Automation
Custom LLM-powered agents, workflow automation (n8n, Make, Zapier), CRM automation (HubSpot, Attio, Pipedrive), data pipelines, and no-code/low-code architecture. Project + retainer model.

## Competitive Position

- Vs OuterSpace: Both run integrated model; Qognition is AI-native, OuterSpace is traditional with AI bolt-ons
- Vs WebFX: WebFX does marketing only; Qognition covers marketing + tech + finance + automation
- Vs Nibnox: Qognition adds finance spoke and deeper execution; Nibnox is advisory-light
- Primary differentiator: AI-native delivery + "operating partner" model vs "agency vendor" model
